title: Replace Dictionary-based PlanContext with typed properties
description:
## Problem
Planning context is passed as `Dictionary<string, object?>` throughout the pipeline. This causes:
- No compile-time type safety
- Magic string keys scattered across the codebase
- Boxing/unboxing overhead for value types
- Difficult to discover available context values

## Solution (Council S52 plan)
Replace with a typed `PlanContext` record class:

```csharp
public sealed record PlanContext(
    IReadOnlyList<ActionData>? PreviousActions,
    WorldState? CurrentWorld,
    int? BuildOriginX, int? BuildOriginY, int? BuildOriginZ,
    string? BlueprintId,
    IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object?> Extensions  // for custom/additional data
);
```

The `Extensions` dictionary provides escape hatch for ad-hoc data while keeping the core contract typed.

## Files
- Agent.Core/Models/PlanContext.cs (new)
- Agent.Planning/ (update all planning interfaces and implementations)
- WebUI.Blazor/AgentBackgroundService.cs (update context construction)

## Validation
- All existing tests pass
- No remaining `Dictionary<string, object?>` for planning context
